Hi,

Thank you for the update. I would like to keep my order Shop····.

Before confirming, could you please confirm that my Thor P2 will be shipped from your EU warehouse to Poland and that there will be no additional import duties or VAT payable upon delivery?

Since the original shipping date shown at the time of purchase was incorrect, would it be possible to apply the $25 goodwill amount as a partial refund to my current order instead of a coupon for a future purchase?

If that is not possible, I will accept the $25 coupon.

Thank you,
Jacek

Hi Jacek,

Thanks for confirming you want to keep the order. Shop···· is paid, and your Thor P2 ships on October 29.

On the warehouse and tax, I have to be straight with you. The T. P2 ships in the US/EU version matched to your address, but it goes out from our US side, not from an EU warehouse, so it is not an import VAT paid shipment. The listed price is the unit price only. Polish import VAT at 21 percent, plus any duty, is charged on delivery by the carrier or customs. We do not collect it at checkout and I cannot quote the exact figure your customs office will raise.

On the $25, I have passed it to Abel and Georges to apply as a partial refund on this order rather than a coupon. A colleague is picking that up today and will confirm it to you by email. If a refund to your original payment method turns out not to be possible, we will send you the $25 coupon instead, and you do not need to do anything either way.

Thanks for your patience on this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
